name: clean-retry-checks-state
rule: clean control: retry gets a per-attempt id and only moves a job that is still running
message: retry failed sync jobs through the queue
body: A sync job that throws is queued again only if it is still running; a cancelled job stays cancelled. Each retry is added under its own id (job id plus attempt) so the queue never drops it as a duplicate. The move from running to queued is one conditional write, and a queue that refuses the add marks the job failed.
